expo.name: iYiYi
expo.description: Meet people within 150ft. Discover nearby users, share content, and connect with your local community in real-time.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: iYiYi uses your location to show your profile to people within your chosen range and to show you who is nearby. For example, when you open Nearby, you see people within 150 ft of you, and in laser tag you see how far away other players are. Other people only see an approximate distance, never your exact location.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: iYiYi uses your photo library so you can choose pictures and videos to post or use as your profile photo. For example, you can pick a photo from your library to set as your profile picture.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: iYiYi uses the camera to take photos and videos you can post, and to aim in camera games. For example, you can take a photo that tags people around you, or aim at another player in laser tag.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: iYiYi uses the microphone to record sound in videos you shoot, your voice in video calls, sounds you record into The Lab, and to hear voice commands for the camera. For example, say "cheese" to take a photo hands-free.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: iYiYi saves the photos and videos you take in the app to your photo library. For example, after you shoot a photo with the iYiYi camera, it is saved to an iYiYi album.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: iYiYi uses your location in the background during laser tag games so you stay connected to the match and other players can see your position even when you switch apps briefly.
